title: Context utilization -- measurement/effect coverage of prompt sources over a run's persisted influence map
description: A derived, read-only coverage view over one run's persisted clozn.context_answer_influence.v1 measurement (run['influence_map']), grouped by ORIGINAL PROMPT SOURCE using only its coarse (never fine/refined) measured spans. 'not_measured' means the bounded influence-measurement selection never scored this source at all -- no influence claim, positive or negative, is available for it, and it must never be described as low-effect. 'below_measured_floor' means the source's measurement completed and every measured coarse-span link stayed below the configured floor -- this means only 'no strong effect was detected under this intervention and measurement threshold for this recorded answer', never that the source was irrelevant, unused, or safe to remove. 'clear_measured_effect' means at least one measured coarse-span link cleared the floor. A below_measured_floor classification requires the underlying measurement to be COMPLETE (matrix_complete and selection.complete_for_selected_spans both true) -- an incomplete matrix degrades the whole response to measurement.state=unavailable rather than ever labeling a partially-measured source as low-effect.

state.description: 'not_measured': no influence map was ever attached to this run, or it cannot be trusted at all. 'unavailable': a persisted artifact exists but cannot honestly be used right now -- status=unavailable, status=error, redacted/stale answer text, or an incomplete measurement matrix (reason=incomplete_influence_matrix). 'available': the measurement was consulted, is structurally complete, and was reconciled with this run's CURRENT answer text.

reason.description: A stable, machine-readable reason. Present on every non-available state; absent when state=available.

method.description: An unchanged copy of the source artifact's method object, including its persistent honesty caveat. Never re-derived.

thresholds.description: An unchanged copy of the source artifact's thresholds object.

fine_span_count.description: Optional metadata only -- fine/refined spans never affect source-level classification.

source_span_id.description: Real clozn.text-span-addresses.v1 address_id for this prompt source. The primary public identity -- never a second addressing scheme.

effect_state.description: Present ONLY when measurement_state=measured. A source that was never measured structurally cannot carry an effect_state -- see this schema's oneOf below.

max_abs_delta_nats.description: Descriptive measurement and deterministic sort key only -- never normalized or compared across differently-sized spans as an importance/utilization score.

code_points.description: Exact Unicode code-point length of this source's exact text, when resolvable. A plain integer count, never source text itself, and never a token estimate.
